title.narrative: Strengthening National Assembly's Capacity for Policy Formulation and Public Dialogue

description.narrative: The grant aims to enhance the implementation of effective development policies in the Republic of Armenia through strengthening National Assembly institutional capacity in policy formulation, legislation development and dialogue with the public. Specific areas of focus will include (i) review of legislation development processes and introduction of modern policy analysis techniques; (ii) initiating a Policy Analysis and Monitoring Center; (iii) modernization of the National Assembly library and (iv) improvement of mechanisms for public dialogue, including civil society organizations and mass media. TF096229 The development objective of the Grant is to increase the effectiveness of interface between the National Assembly and its constituents, as well as to promote better techniques for policy analysis through capacity building and methodological guidelines and internal regulations. The specific areas of focus will include (i) review of legislative development processes and introduction of modern policy analysis techniques; (ii) initiating development of a Policy Analysis and Monitoring Center; (iii) modernization of the National Assembly library; and (iv) improving mechanisms for public dialogue, including civil society organizations and mass media.
